ShortDescription.Value: ICAO-based airport markings, modular decals and pavement surfaces.

Publish.LongDescription:
## A continuation by the original creator
This is the sequel and updated edition of my earlier [Airport Details Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/113207/Windows), developed by the same creator.
ICAO Annex 14 is the design baseline. The aim is strict application of the real definitions, purposes, patterns and dimensions of airport markings, so runway, taxiway and apron components can be assembled into coherent, realistic layouts. This edition reworks the documented marking geometry and adds modular parts for more detailed airport builds.
## Included in this edition
- Runway numbers, threshold stripes, centre lines, aiming points, touchdown-zone markings, edge lines, displaced-threshold arrows and closure markings. - Taxiway centre lines, enhanced centre lines, holding-position patterns and non-load-bearing pavement boundaries. - Transparent white, black and yellow characters in 1 m, 2 m and 4 m sizes, decimal points and matching arrows, with modular backgrounds and thin outlines. - Aircraft-stand guidance and apron safety lines, including wider continuous guidance, CAAM secondary guidance and a turn bar. - Eight transparent nose-in stand templates, from small general aviation to large widebody stands, with separately positioned stop bars and aircraft labels. - CAAC and CAAM stop-marking variants, passenger boarding bridge movement and wheel parking marks, framed no-parking areas and equipment parking outlines. - Asphalt, concrete and paint surfaces, plus test variants for subtle pavement normals and transparent CAAM no-parking hatching.
Choose each marking for its intended use and airport layout. The creator's character artwork uses ICAO font sources; colour and placement presets are chosen for game scenery, and this is not a claim of ICAO certification. CAAM variants are identified separately. The A2/B2 holding-position patterns follow the Annex 14 provisions applicable from 26 November 2026.
Version 0.6.6 is currently a local test build. Runway centre lines, secondary guidance dashes, the red hatch surface and save/reload have passed user testing. Stand templates and apron details need in-game validation, together with the refined concrete grain and low-light lettering carried over from 0.6.5. Template footprints are conservative scenery presets; match the selected aircraft, stop positions and bridge geometry before duplicating a layout.
## Recommended companion assets
These are optional additions. Follow each asset's game-version requirements and required dependencies.
**G87 materials and road markings**
I regularly use G87's packs and recommend their quality. [Vanilla Asphalt](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/97145/Windows), [Vanilla Pavement](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/99944/Windows), [Road Markings](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/97828/Windows) and [Stripes and Chevrons](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/98624/Windows) provide complementary pavement materials, road markings and hatching, especially useful around service roads and the surrounding airport infrastructure.
This pack already includes basic asphalt, concrete and paint surfaces; G87 adds further material and marking choices. Check overlapping surfaces and markings in a small area first, as pavement surfaces can cover markings from another pack. Ordinary road hatching should be selected for the airport function it represents.
**Airport props and lighting**
- [Airport Pack by peijo](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/147286/Any): illuminated blank taxiway sign bodies, coloured airfield lights, approach-light structures and ILS props. Write Everywhere is needed to add sign inscriptions. Its current release targets game 1.6.*; public feedback is limited. - [LAX Airport Props - No Landmark Buildings DLC](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/128482/Any): airport buildings, jetways, blast fences, baggage props and lighting. Keep both required HarbourmasterJay prefab packs updated; the rendering dependency was repaired for game 1.6.2. The [original LAX edition](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/128477/Any) also requires Landmark Buildings DLC. - [Runway Guard Light by kjmci](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/150288/Any): an alternating flashing guard-light prop for runway holding positions. Its current release targets game 1.6.*; independent compatibility feedback is limited. - MCN PAPI [red](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/141582/Any) and [white](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/141583/Any): optional visual props for PAPI assemblies. They currently declare game 1.5.* compatibility; compatibility with newer versions and viewing-angle-dependent colour changes have not been verified.
These suggestions are based on the creators' descriptions, update records and available public reports. Joint in-game compatibility testing with this edition is still pending.
## Planned expansion
Future updates will gradually expand airport service-road markings, special instruction and information markings, additional aircraft-stand configurations, and apron/ramp safety lines and stripes.
Each addition will be researched against ICAO requirements and relevant guidance before implementation. FAA documents will be used for comparison and clearly identified US-specific variants where appropriate. Equipment areas, no-parking hatching, vehicle crossings and aircraft guidance will be treated according to their actual purpose and local rules.
